release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.7.5 (Build 68): Push Notifications System, Decommissioned Biometrics, Hardened Security, and Human Professional UX.
• Real Push Notifications: Full cross-device remote push notification engine powered by Expo Push Gateway and Supabase Realtime—delivers instant native heads-up alerts to parents when restricted apps are launched, PINs are used, or permissions are changed, and to students when study goals or app passes are updated.
• Biometric & Face ID Unlock Decommissioned: Removed all biometric unlock vectors to prevent child fingerprint bypass—ensures parental PIN or curriculum MCQs are strictly required to unguard apps.
• Clean Legal & Compliance Layout: Fixed squished text hierarchy on profile and settings screens.
• Human Professional Tone: Removed all robotic AI buzzwords ("calibration", "telemetry", "dossier", "cognitive diagnosis") across every student, parent, and admin screen.
• Production Security Hardening: Enforced role verification on Admin/Parent routes, eliminated fallback default PIN bypass, and removed client-exposed credentials.
